description: This file defines the ProviderDAO interface for data access operations related to Provider entities in the OpenMRS project. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations, retrieval by various attributes, and role management related to providers.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Provider objects, optionally including retired providers.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves or updates a Provider entity.

methods.name: deleteProvider
methods.description: Deletes an existing Provider.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Finds Providers associated with a specific Person, with an option to include retired Provider.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Providers based on name, attributes, pagination, and retired status.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns the count of Providers matching specified name and retired status.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all ProviderAttributeType objects, optionally including retired types.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by its UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttributeType by its name.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderAttributeType.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderAttribute by its UUID.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a Provider's identifier is unique.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider by its identifier.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ProviderRole by its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Retrieves Providers matching a list of roles, with an option to include retired providers.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Fetches all ProviderRoles, with an option to include retired roles.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a ProviderRole.

methods.name: deleteProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a ProviderRole.
